title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29167v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. translated_title: TeachBack：通过双向偏好优化实现在线策略自蒸馏的“学会教学”
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使语言模型能够从一个“教师”模型学习，该教师由同一个模型实例化而来，但被赋予了特权信息，例如参考答案。我们发现，拥有充分的特权信息可以让教师生成高度准确的轨迹；然而，仅凭准确性并不能保证这些轨迹适合学生学习。直接获取完整答案可能会促使教师生成简短的、依赖参考答案的推导，从而省略了在没有特权信息的情况下解决问题所必需的探索、验证和自我纠正等过程。我们提出了TeachBack，这是一个用于在线策略自蒸馏的双向偏好学习框架，它不仅从教师那里学习，还学习教师应该如何教学。TeachBack通过控制注入到提示中的参考推理后缀的长度等方式来塑造教师的生成行为……
tldr: TeachBack提出了一种双向偏好学习框架，使模型不仅从掌握特权信息的教师处学习，还反过来优化教师的教学方式，从而生成更适合学生学习的推理轨迹。
en_tdlr: TeachBack is a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that not only learns from the Teacher but also optimizes how the Teacher should teach, yielding reasoning trajectories better suited for student learning.
